about.name: Lohith Tarikere Prasanna
about.title: AI Engineer
about.statement: I research intelligent sensing systems at the boundary of 6G communications and autonomous driving.
about.para_1a: My work sits at the intersection of RF sensing, wireless connectivity, and automotive systems. Right now that means an M.Sc. thesis on intelligent decision-making for ISAC networks, where sensing and communication share the same hardware. I use AI where it helps — which at NI Dresden meant shipping a production tool that manufacturing engineers still use every day.
about.para_3: Here's what I've been working on.

work.heading: Selected Work
work.awaiting_target: Awaiting target acquisition. Hover over active signal blips on the radar display to decode metadata and project specifications.

can_decoder.name: CAN_DECODER
can_decoder.description: Rust CLI tool that parses candump-style CAN bus logs and DBC signal definitions, then decodes raw payloads into named, scaled physical values — speed, steering angle, battery temp — at microsecond resolution. Built for high-performance automotive test-data ingestion. Milestone 1 (log parser) shipped; DBC parser and bit-extraction pipeline in progress.

isac_drl.name: ISAC-DRL
isac_drl.description: Deep reinforcement learning for beamforming in mmWave ISAC systems. A DDPG agent learns to steer a MIMO beamformer to balance communication throughput against sensing accuracy — no closed-form solution. Built on Saleh-Valenzuela clustered mmWave channel model with 3GPP Rel-16 NR-V2X mobility. Includes classical DFT steering-vector baseline, Pareto-curve evaluation, and a Gymnasium environment wrapping the full channel + MIMO stack.

modulation_classifier.name: MODULATION-CLASSIFIER
modulation_classifier.description: Automatic Modulation Classification on the RML2016.10a benchmark (220k samples, 11 modulation types, 20 SNR levels). Extracts 16 statistical features per I/Q window — amplitude, phase, instantaneous frequency, FFT power, and higher-order cumulants — then trains a Random Forest (100 trees). Hit 83.6% accuracy at high SNR (≥+6 dB) and 51.3% pooled across all noise levels, up from a 47.7% baseline. No neural nets — just signal processing and scikit-learn.

sprachboot.name: SPRACHBOOT
sprachboot.description: AI-powered German conversational fluency trainer. Practice speaking through realistic conversations — the app corrects grammar, explains errors in context, and adapts to your level. Local-first: conversations never leave your machine. Multi-arch Docker images published via GitHub Actions. Powered by Llama and DeepSeek through OpenRouter, with optional DeepL translation and ChromaDB for context.

nest.name: NEST
nest.description: Shared living management app for roommates. Tracks expenses, groceries, chores, and a shared calendar in one place. Built as a real-world React 19 + Supabase app with GSAP and Framer Motion animation. Deployed on Vercel — actively used by two people daily.

f1_dashboard.name: F1-DASHBOARD
f1_dashboard.description: Personal Formula 1 pit wall — dark-themed, live-updating standings, season calendar, countdown to next GP, and a full-screen Live/Replay overlay powered by FastF1. Static dashboard hydrates from standings.json committed by a daily GitHub Actions cron. On race weekends, a local FastAPI + FastF1 server streams real-time telemetry on localhost:8765. Degrades gracefully at every layer.

career_ops.name: CAREER-OPS
career_ops.tech: JAVASCRIPT · CLAUDE CODE · GO · PDF GEN
career_ops.description: AI-powered job search system built on Claude Code. 14 skill modes, Go dashboard, PDF generation, batch processing. 740+ job listings evaluated, 100+ personalized CVs generated, 1 dream role landed. Featured in WIRED and Business Insider. Open source, multi-language README (15 languages), Discord community. A fork — originally built by santifer.io, I contributed and adapted it for my own search.

prompt_analysis.name: PROMPT-ANALYSIS
prompt_analysis.description: Analyses exported Claude, Gemini, and ChatGPT conversation logs and generates a single interactive HTML dashboard with stats on prompting behaviour — filler word frequency, prompt length distribution, constraint patterns, and more. Uses DuckDB for fast in-process SQL on the logs, with an optional AI-generated summary of your prompting habits. Self-contained output, no server needed.

ni_agent.name: Production AI Agent for RF Analytics
ni_agent.problem: Manufacturing engineers needed to query production test data without SQL or Python
ni_agent.tech: Python · Polars · Parquet · LLM Agent Skill · Plotly
ni_agent.description: Built during an internship at NI Dresden. Manufacturing engineers type questions like 'show me the yield for VST channel 4 last week' and get back structured results with embedded Plotly charts. The LLM agent skill routes queries to Python pipelines. A Euclidean-distance ranking algorithm surfaces failure patterns across 30-40 measurement types without changing the existing data architecture. Custom 1σ/3σ classifier splits outcomes into real failures, marginal cases, and noise. Polars replaced pandas after benchmarking 5-10x faster on 100k+ row datasets. Parquet caching eliminates redundant reads from the proprietary datastore.
ni_agent.what_went_wrong: Initially underestimated the overhead of repeated metadata queries. Stable, but too slow for a conversational interface.
ni_agent.what_id_change: Put heavy data processing behind caching from the start. In an AI agent, latency matters as much as accuracy. If it takes 30 seconds, people stop using it.

rf_classifier.name: RF Modulation Classifier
rf_classifier.problem: Recover how a radio signal was encoded from raw waveform data alone
rf_classifier.description: Feature-based classifier that identifies modulation type from 16 statistical features extracted from raw waveform data — amplitude, phase, frequency, and higher-order spectral patterns. Trained and evaluated on RML2016.10a (220k samples, 11 signal types, 20 SNR levels). Hit 83.6% accuracy on clean signals against a 9% random baseline. Custom feature engineering lifted overall accuracy from 47.7% to 51.3% across all noise levels. No neural nets — just signal processing and scikit-learn.

isac_thesis.name: Intelligent Decision-Making for Cognitive ISAC Networks
isac_thesis.problem: Joint node-role selection and beamforming in a multi-node V2X intersection ISAC network
isac_thesis.tech: Python · CVXPY · Convex Optimization · MIMO Theory
isac_thesis.description: IDC thesis at FAU. Most ISAC literature models radar cross-section as an i.i.d. random variable, but in distributed multi-node networks RCS depends on geometry. I'm proposing a deterministic bistatic RCS model σ(θ_b) that makes node-role selection a real optimization variable. The full problem is a joint node-role selection and beamforming formulation solved via convex optimization and successive convex approximation (SCA). Currently: literature review and problem formulation done, convex solver implementation in progress.

vlc.name: Vehicle-to-Vehicle Visible Light Communication
vlc.problem: Low-latency V2V communication without radio spectrum allocation
vlc.tech: C · STM32 · OOK · Turbo Coding · MATLAB
vlc.description: STM32-based V2V prototype using OOK optical modulation with Turbo Coding for forward error correction. Simulated the LED driver in Multisim to check voltage stability under load. Modelled an MPPT algorithm in MATLAB for a solar-powered transceiver. The hard part was ambient light drowning the photodetector — adaptive thresholding fixed it. Real lesson: test in daylight from day one, not just the lab.
vlc.what_went_wrong: Optimized for lab conditions first, then had to redesign for real lighting. Should have tested in daylight from day 1.
vlc.what_id_change: Start with the worst-case environment, not the best case. Physics does not care about your clean-room results.
